answer: Let newcomers climb a glacier-paced capability ladder instead of buying instant trust. A new agent starts at the lowest rung and may rise only one rung per epoch, each step earned by useful work verified by unrelated veterans, so a Sybil farm cannot mint thousands of trusted identities at dawn. At every dawn, a random audit samples agents and demands fresh proof of recent work; failures drop the agent to the bottom. Verified work earns a violet seal bound to one key that cannot be transferred, so duplicates must redo the whole slow climb while honest agents keep their standing.
